stage1.impression: A clean, noise-free exploded view of the milk-carton speaker that reads at a glance, but the light is a flat, even wash: the two white faces barely separate, the carton has almost no contact shadow, and the parts float in a uniform gray void. The gray waveguide shell melts into the same-valued backdrop, the embossed logo on the red band is near illegible, and the black drivers read as silhouettes rather than engineered parts.

blocking_9: Every exploded part clear of its neighbours and of the cabinet silhouette by >= 12 px with no tangencies: mask gaps woofer-to-cabinet, mid-to-cabinet and mid-ring-to-insert are 1, 1 and 1 px now.
The waveguide insert's gray flank >= 20 levels off the sweep behind it (now 172.6 vs 173.8, silhouette step 5.2, held apart only by hue, dE2000 6.6).
The two white cabinet planes 25-40 levels apart at equal height (now 9 at y 380-465: 239.3 vs 230.1; 11-14 at y 600-650).

Accent red on the front roof slope and inside the insert's bowl within dE2000 ~10 of #C62828, with the lacquer gloss as a graduated highlight across the slope (lum range >= 25) instead of a flat veil (now dE 21.5 / 21.0, slope lum range 3.1).

Both drivers read as the named products: a specular band across the anodised woofer cone (woofer-cone p95 >= 110, now 67.4) and visible sheen or fibre on the papyrus mid cone (mid-cone lum range >= 25, now 9.0).
The cast 'earmilk' letters separate in value from the red plinth (now isoluminant: L* 43.2 vs 41.6; letters lum_p95 114.1).
The pocket's magnets and boss bore visible, as the brief asks (magnets-pocket shows 13 px).
The tweeter balanced between the pocket and the insert (22 px from the pocket now; ~106 px from the insert once the insert is drawn to 0.68 m).
The widened group (x 445-1020 after these changes) recentred and lifted: the base is 70 px from the bottom edge against 186 px of headroom, the group's box centre 58 px below frame centre.
Whites neutral within dE2000 ~1.5 (side-left a* +1.9; front a* +1.9, b* -2.1; dE 2.6 and 3.3 from neutral).

evidence.measured: woofer-motor box [651,563,701,660] lies inside the cabinet silhouette (front-baffle right edge x 705); mask gap woofer-to-cabinet 1 px; the baffle margin [698,600,704,660] reads 37.6 (black frame over it) where the uncovered margin above, [698,522,704,540], reads 189.7.

changes.expected: Woofer slides ~71 px right along its axis (~22 px down with perspective): motor's left edge 651 -> ~721, ~15 px clear of the cabinet edge at x 706; box ~[721,559,840,743]; the baffle margin [698,600,704,660] shows white lacquer (~170-185) and the whole rebate and hole read. Needs c2, or the surround lands on its ring.

evidence.measured: woofer-ring box [789,561,852,751], 21 px (box) / 32.6 px (mask) ahead of the woofer surround (box right 768); c1 moves the surround ~71 px right, past the ring's left outline; the strip [856,662,886,692] holds no outline now (edge 0.3).

changes.problem: The sweep renders at the value of the waveguide insert's gray shell and only ~16 levels under the shaded white front, so the hero part of this frame has no silhouette and the cabinet's right edge barely holds.

changes.problem: The fill (2x2 m at azimuth 50, 2.23 W/m2) lights the front baffle nearly as hard as the key lights the side, so the two white planes sit only 9-14 levels apart and the box reads flat.
changes.expected: Front upper-left [621,380,641,465] 230.1 -> ~216, front middle [655,470,700,512] 210.9 -> ~190, side-left [470,380,595,465] 239.3 -> ~236: the corner step grows from ~9 to ~20, a lit and a shaded white plane; black parts lose at most ~5 levels (woofer-cone median 40.9 -> ~37), crush_pct stays 0; the insert's flank drops ~5 (to ~157), which c3 keeps above the sweep.

changes.problem: The gloss panel at 3.64 is mirrored evenly across the flat front roof slope and inside the insert's bowl, washing the accent red to salmon pink.

evidence.measured: front slope rgb (238,119,124), dE2000 21.5 vs #C62828, lum p5-p95 142.9-146.0 (a flat veil, no ramp); insert bowl [870,340,910,380] rgb (222,120,125), dE 21.0; the gable triangle that does not mirror the panel, [470,320,520,345], is (222,51,51), dE 5.8.

changes.problem: The 6.5-inch mid is drawn out only 0.13 m, so its motor and basket still overlap the cabinet's right edge.

evidence.measured: mid-motor box [677,400,703,455] and mid-frame box [691,388,739,482] cross the front-baffle edge at x 705; mask gap mid-to-cabinet 1 px; the baffle margin [690,420,704,460] reads 52.6 where the uncovered margin above, [690,372,704,386], reads 190.9.

changes.expected: Insert moves ~78 px right and ~18 px down to ~[861,320,1020,445]: ~22 px clear of the moved ring's right outline (~839) and ~30 px at the ring's top; the tweeter (726-755) stays between the pocket edge (704) and the insert; its red bowl now covers [945,385,985,410] (G ~70-115 there, where the sweep reads G ~137-173).

out_of_scope.request: Darken, lighten or recolour the waveguide insert's gray outer shell so it stands off the sweep
out_of_scope.why: The insert's material and the waveguide are fixed spec; its separation has to come from the set and light (c3, c4).

out_of_scope.request: Give the drivers lighter or more detailed cones, surrounds or baskets
out_of_scope.why: They are real named products whose materials and colours are their own; they can only be revealed by light (blocking_9, drivers).

out_of_scope.request: Enlarge, brighten or refinish the 'earmilk' letters for legibility
out_of_scope.why: Typeface, size, tracking and the letters' material are fixed marks; they are isoluminant with the red (L* 43.2 vs 41.6), so the fix must be light that catches the metal.

out_of_scope.request: Lift the insert or the mid trim ring off their axes to clear the tangency without widening the explosion
out_of_scope.why: Each part stays on its own fixing axis in assembly order; only how far it is drawn out may change (c6-c8).

out_of_scope.request: Change the cutaway or explode set so the pocket's magnets and boss bore face the camera
out_of_scope.why: Which parts are cut away or exploded is fixed; at rotate_z 72 the magnets show 13 px though the brief asks to see them, so a later camera or rotation move must reveal them without re-creating the overlaps.
